meta.title: Reverse auction (tick 1): lower by 0.5 (less than the tick)

steps.note: Open the prepared live reverse-auction event with Vendor A's existing bid.
Move to the separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live auction's pricing bid sheet for Vendor A.

args.because: Quoted price difference must be greater than the tick size

steps.note: Attempt to revise the bid from 100 to 99.5 and require Procol's tick-size refusal.
Return to the buyer session after the vendor revision attempt.
Open Master QCS to verify the buyer still sees the unchanged bid.
Confirm the rejected revision did not replace the original bid of 100.
